state.task: Using the supplied numerical features extracted from a cardiotocography (CTG) recording, classify fetal state as normal, suspect, or pathologic. Select one class. This task does not ask whether delivery or another treatment should be performed.

feature_descriptions.MSTV: Mean short-term variability (source scale; no unit conversion)
feature_descriptions.MLTV: Mean long-term variability (source scale; no unit conversion)
feature_descriptions.Variance: FHR histogram variance (source scale; no unit conversion)
feature_descriptions.Tendency: Histogram tendency code: -1 left-skewed, 0 symmetric, 1 right-skewed (source coding)

context.note: Original 21 numerical features extracted from a CTG segment; not a waveform caption. Original spreadsheet precision retained; no unit conversion.

task_definition.target: Predict the expert-assigned fetal-state category for the supplied CTG recording: normal, suspect, or pathologic. These are mutually exclusive reference categories, not the ten-category morphological pattern labels.
task_definition.scope: Input consists of extracted numerical summaries, not the original waveform. Do not invent unseen waveform features. No exact deterministic mapping from these summaries to the expert labels is supplied; this is classification using clinical knowledge, not execution of a fully specified waveform rule. Do not infer a delivery indication, treatment, or future neonatal outcome from the class label.

field_descriptions.task: Decision question and response instructions; not a patient observation.
field_descriptions.context: Patient information available for this task; absent findings are unknown, not normal.
field_descriptions.options: Map of option IDs to candidate meanings. IDs are response symbols, not measurements or severity scores.
field_descriptions.task_definition: General endpoint, time-window and scope rules shared across cases; not the case outcome.
field_descriptions.context.features: 21 numerical features extracted from the same CTG segment, not a waveform or sequence of 21 timepoints.
field_descriptions.context.feature_descriptions: Source feature names and short descriptions; explicit feature entries below include coding and unit caveats.
field_descriptions.context.note: Representation and precision note; not a clinical observation.
field_descriptions.context.features.AC: FHR accelerations per second, not an event count or per-minute rate.
field_descriptions.context.features.DL: Light FHR decelerations per second, as extracted by the source.
field_descriptions.context.features.DS: Severe FHR decelerations per second, as extracted by the source.
field_descriptions.context.features.DP: Prolonged FHR decelerations per second, as extracted by the source.
field_descriptions.context.features.ASTV: Percentage of time with abnormal short-term variability; percent, not a fraction.
field_descriptions.context.features.MSTV: Mean short-term variability; original source scale, with no verified physical unit or conversion assumed.
field_descriptions.context.features.ALTV: Percentage of time with abnormal long-term variability; percent, not a fraction.
field_descriptions.context.features.MLTV: Mean long-term variability; original source scale, with no verified physical unit or conversion assumed.
field_descriptions.context.features.Width: Width of the FHR histogram, in FHR-axis units (beats/min), not time duration.
field_descriptions.context.features.Min: Lower FHR value of the histogram, beats/min; not the smallest histogram bin count.
field_descriptions.context.features.Max: Upper FHR value of the histogram, beats/min; not the largest histogram bin count.
field_descriptions.context.features.Nmax: Number of peaks in the FHR histogram, a count.
field_descriptions.context.features.Nzeros: Number of histogram zeros as extracted by the source, a count; not episodes of absent heartbeat.
field_descriptions.context.features.Mode: Mode of the FHR histogram, beats/min.
field_descriptions.context.features.Mean: Mean of the FHR histogram, beats/min.
field_descriptions.context.features.Median: Median of the FHR histogram, beats/min.
field_descriptions.context.features.Variance: FHR histogram variance on the original source scale; no unverified physical-unit conversion assumed.
field_descriptions.context.features.Tendency: Histogram asymmetry code: -1=left asymmetric, 0=symmetric, 1=right asymmetric. Not a worsening-risk score.
field_descriptions.field_descriptions: Data dictionary: keys are input-relative paths; []=every array item; [0]/[1]=zero-based positional columns. Descriptions are not patient observations or answers.
field_descriptions.options.A: Candidate meaning for response ID A; the option text defines the category/action, not whether it is correct.
field_descriptions.options.B: Candidate meaning for response ID B; the option text defines the category/action, not whether it is correct.
field_descriptions.options.C: Candidate meaning for response ID C; the option text defines the category/action, not whether it is correct.
field_descriptions.task_definition.target: Definition of the decision target and candidate meanings.
field_descriptions.task_definition.scope: Permitted evidence, missing-information rules and limits of the task.
